# General needs by role

**Not in use yet: to be finished later.** Needs that people in a role have whatever the app is, in plain words. Later, `/pre.needs` will add the ones for the roles an app has, each with the source "general needs: <role>", for review like any other need.

## Every user
- Users need their personal data protected.
- Users need the product to work when they need it.
- Users need to understand how to use it without help.
- Users need their effort not to be lost.
- Users need to be able to use it whatever their abilities.
- Users need it to cost only what they're willing to pay.
- Users need to trust what it tells them.

## Product owner
- The owner needs the product to fund itself, or to stay within the budget.
- The owner needs users to trust the product.
- The owner needs the product to comply with the law.
- The owner needs to be free of licence-related legal issues.
- The owner needs to know whether the product is working for its users.
- The owner needs the product's reputation protected.

## Maintainer (developer)
- Maintainers need to understand the system quickly.
- Maintainers need to change it without breaking what works.
- Maintainers need to find out quickly when something breaks.
- Maintainers need upkeep to fit the time they have.
- Maintainers need the parts it depends on to stay supported.

## Operator (whoever runs it)
- Operators need it to run within the resources they have.
- Operators need to recover data after a failure.
- Operators need to update it without losing data.

## People whose content or data is used
- Authors need credit, and their licence terms respected.
- People described in the data need their privacy respected.

## Parents and guardians
- Parents need to protect their children.
- Parents need to know what their children share.

## Teachers (domain: education)
- Teachers need control over their teaching materials and who sees them.
- Teachers need information on how their students are doing.
- Teachers need to save time.

## Learners, any subject (domain: learning)
- Learners need material at their own level.
- Learners need an idea of their level and their progress.
- Learners need to remember what they've learned.
- Learners need to stay motivated.
- Learners need flexibility in where, when and how long they learn.
- Learners need confidence that their efforts are worthwhile.

## Language learners (domain: language learning)
- Language learners need plenty of input they can understand.
- Language learners need to understand the spoken language.
- Language learners need to express themselves in the language.
- Language learners need to understand how the language works.
- Language learners need to meet the language as it's really used.
- Language learners need what they know to become automatic.
- Language learners need to learn the language they choose.
